- RPC `State.Put`: descriptor `trellis_runtime_generated::apis::state::rpc::StatePutRpc`, low-level `trellis_client.call::<trellis_runtime_generated::apis::state::rpc::StatePutRpc>(...)`, generated wrapper `.rpc().state().put(...)`
## Participant `trellis.auth-runtime`
Connect through `trellis_runtime_generated::participants::auth_runtime::Participant`.

Prepared events and outbox/inbox:
- Generated event structs are event bodies only; runtime metadata is separate from the body payload.
- `PreparedTrellisEvent` captures a validated subject, encoded body payload, preserved transport headers, event id, and event time.
- Published prepared events send the runtime event id from `event_id()` and `Trellis-Event-Time` from `event_time()`.
- Use `subscribe_messages::<Descriptor>(...)` and `EventMessage::event_id()` / `event_time()` when subscribers need metadata.
- Use `prepare_event::<Descriptor>(...)`, `publish_prepared(...)`, and `dispatch_outbox_once(...)` for durable publish flows.
- Runtime stores include `OutboxStore`, `InboxStore`, `SqliteOutboxStore`, `SqliteInboxStore`, `PostgresOutboxStore`, and `PostgresInboxStore`.
